length_definition: total_length includes prefix; control_length excludes it

protocol.admission: first candidates surviving seven uniform random actions; no future filtering
protocol.evaluation_rng: all stored keys shared across families and training policy seeds
protocol.reset_distribution: original S.make(spec), uniform; fresh simulator texture key retained

score_scope: conditional on survival of the seven random prefix actions
trace_selection: first three admitted episodes, irrespective of outcome
